items.title: 第 1 题 · 计算机病毒是一种能自我繁殖的特殊小程序
items.style: 扁平轻幽默插画，暖橙底，深棕粗线条，带一点卡通感
items.layout: A＝队伍里的伪装者｜B＝小程序侵入与潜伏｜C＝三种说法划叉｜D＝结论条
items.prompt: Flat humorous illustration, landscape, four-zone layout, warm orange background, dark brown thick outlines, light cartoon feel, not scary. Zone A (left, about 60% width): a queue of friendly laptop characters walking in a line toward a doorway; among them one figure wears a paper mask and a nametag that reads like an ordinary program, its true spiky outline only faintly visible under the disguise; a security guard at the door checks nametags with a magnifier and has not yet noticed the impostor; a small suitcase, a queue rope, a signpost and a potted plant complete the scene; dotted footprints behind the impostor show it came from off-screen. Zone B (upper right): a small program block drawn as a rounded square with two short code lines inside, connected by dotted arrows to three small behaviour badges — two identical smaller copies (self-replication), a closed drawer (lying dormant) and a spreading chain of dots across neighbouring blocks; a small broken-plug icon marks the damage badge at the end. Zone C (lower right): a pale card with three rows of small tags, each row struck through with a thin grey line — a flu germ, a microbe, a plain document sheet. Zone D (bottom full-width bar): a warm rounded conclusion strip with a green check badge. Text on the image is Simplified Chinese only, in four short labels: "病毒", "小程序", "潜伏", "繁殖" — bold brown rounded type on white rounded plates, each label no more than three characters. 16:9 landscape, high resolution, clean background.

items.prompt: Network topology illustration, landscape, four-zone layout, deep blue background with teal glowing lines, subtle grid, tech feel. Zone A (left, about 60% width): a post office counter where a thick book is being cut into stacked chapters; an clerk seals each chapter into its own small envelope, numbers each envelope with a stamp and drops them into a sorting chute; the envelopes then travel along three different coloured delivery routes across the panel; at the far right a recipient lays the received envelopes out in numeric order and reassembles the book; a trolley, a scale and a stamp pad complete the scene. Zone B (upper right): a horizontal pipeline diagram — one large data block on the left breaks into six small numbered packets; the packets fan out across three parallel paths with different node boxes on each path; on the right the packets arrive out of order and slide into numbered slots in a reassembly frame; small path lines connect the nodes and the frame glows once complete. Zone D (bottom full-width bar): a dark rounded conclusion strip with a teal check badge.
